title: Bestco says unauthorized access to a system may have leaked Best Kobetsu customer and inquiry records, 最大14万6,133 in total
date_note: Cybersecurity.com (Japan, 24 Nov) says Bestco confirmed the access on 20 Nov and announced the possible leak on 21 Nov.
geo_basis: country; location not stated in the source
summary: Cybersecurity.com (Japan) reports that Bestco, operator of the Best Kobetsu cram school, confirmed unauthorized third-party access to a system it uses on 20 November and announced on 21 November that personal data may have leaked. The possible scope is 最大5万196 enrolled-customer records and 最大9万5,937 past inquiry records, 最大14万6,133 in total (the report's wording for at most). The company has not given the cause or intrusion route.
plain: A Japanese cram school operator says unauthorized access to a system it uses may have leaked customer and inquiry records, 最大14万6,133 in total. The company has not given the cause.
exec: Bestco's possible leak covers 最大14万6,133 records; the company has not disclosed the cause or intrusion route.
action: Bestco asks users to change their education app passwords and to beware of suspicious emails, SMS and calls impersonating the company.
impact: Names, contact details, grades and payment information may be affected, per the report; credit card data is reportedly not included.
